title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Was Made for You?
excerpt: Discover whether soft glam or full glam is the perfect match for your bridal vision and wedding day aesthetic.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, subtle definition, and a romantic glow that feels effortlessly elegant — ideal for garden or beach weddings. Full glam turns up the drama with bold lashes, sculpted contour, and rich color that commands attention under grand ballroom lighting. At Velora Bella, our luxury artists tailor every look to your venue, gown, and personality so your makeup feels authentically and beautifully yours.

title: Beyond the Veil: Luxury Bridal Beauty Trends Redefining the Modern Bride
excerpt: Discover the opulent beauty trends shaping 2026 brides, from luminous skin finishes to bold, editorial-inspired looks.
content: Today's luxury brides are embracing a stunning fusion of timeless elegance and avant-garde artistry, with glass-skin techniques, 24-karat gold-infused products, and custom-blended foundation formulas leading the way. Soft sculpting and ethereal, candlelit highlight placements are replacing heavy contouring, creating a breathtaking natural radiance that photographs beautifully. At Velora Bella, we craft each bridal look as a wearable masterpiece tailored exclusively to your unique beauty.
